## Chimney Dust (G4)

**Who she is.** A pale mint/aqua Earth-pony mare with a muted purple mane, violet eyes, and a **chimney-and-sweep cutie mark**. She is a chimney sweep in the Canterlot scenes of *A Hearth’s Warming Tail* (season 6, episode 8). Around **13:37**, **Twinkleshine** shares hot cocoa with her. She belongs to the **story Twilight reads to Starlight**, so this is a character in that in-universe tale, not a separately established present-day Ponyville resident. Sources: [pony index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies), [Twinkleshine appearance guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Twinkleshine), [episode synopsis](https://www.nowtv.com/watch/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/iYEQYZ6ymh22BCLb91Vd3m/seasons/6/episodes/a-hearths-warming-tail-episode-8/A5EK3JYiLcaCh7cBi19VN).

**Name and voice.** “Chimney Dust” is a **wiki/community identification**, also used for a screenshot filename. I could not verify it as a spoken, credited, merchandise, or production-confirmed official name, nor trace who coined it. **No individual dialogue or credited voice actor was verified.** No further appearances or alternate identities are confirmed.
